newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks surge up on U.S., domestic CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks surge up on U.S., domestic CPI data.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed with big gains on Friday following unexpectedly tame inflation figures both domestically and in the United States.
Dealers said the buoyant mood on the bourse would bring about further advances in the short term.
The general index was up 3.84 points, 1.08 percent, at 358.00 and the Ibex-35 rose 48.87 points, 1.21 percent, to 4,079.31.
"If there aren't problems with next year's budget, we will shortly see new year highs," one dealer said.
Volume was bloated with 40.45 billion pesetas in business done, one third of it in Telefonica and electricity firm Iberdrola which had 5.4 million shares traded.
Dealers said there were some minor technical problems at the 3,100 barrier in the Ibex, but they were not insurmountable.
Telefonica gained 50 pesetas, 2.14 percent, to 2,385 with 3.1 million shares traded.
